history: Independent root; previous commits are not ancestors of this baseline.

scope.retained: All maintained source, tests, fixtures, licenses, dependency pins and lockfiles, byte-for-byte from the source tree.
scope.attributes: Preserve existing CRLF blobs in ten pinned inputs/historical probe files without normalization during fresh checkout creation.
